title: 情報工学特別講義Ⅶ(基本情報処理技術者試験対策講座2)
subtitle: Special Lecture for Information and Computer Science 7
keywords: FE 2.security 3.project management 4.system strategy and management strategy 5.corporate and legal
educationalGoal: “Fundamental Information Technology Engineer Examination (FE)” is known as the gateway to success for new ICT engineers, The FE is divided into the first half and the second half on the test day, and it is necessary to pass both of the examinations at the same day. Students will learn ICT skills to pass the first half of the FE exam.
advice: This is a countermeasure course to pass the first half of the FE exam. We will cover the following materials: 1. Security 2. Project management service management 3. System audit 4. System strategy 5. System planning 6. Technology strategy management Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class. Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and on a regular basis.
books: Textbooks: 1. WENet, "System management and computerization", Tokyo: WENet, 2020 Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: This course requires the following knowledge/skills: 1. The units of “Programming 1”and “Programming 2” have been acquired. 2. The units of "Introduction to Engineering (Information and Computer Science)". 3. Knowledge of basic logical operation.
